scripts.start:services: npx concurrently -n gateway,auth,course,order,admin,platform,platform-worker,downloads -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,gray,red "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:course" "npm run start:order" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:platform" "npm run start:platform-worker" "npm run start:downloads"
scripts.start:gateway: cd services/api-gateway && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000 node src/server.js
scripts.start:auth: cd services/auth-service && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=4001 node src/server.js
scripts.start:course: cd services/course-service && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=4002 node src/server.js
scripts.start:order: cd services/order-service && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=4003 node src/server.js
scripts.start:admin: cd services/admin-service && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=4004 node src/server.js
scripts.start:platform: cd services/platform-service && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=4005 node src/server.js
scripts.start:platform-worker: cd services/platform-service && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node src/workers/article-publish-worker.js
scripts.start:downloads: cd services/downloads-service && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=4006 node src/server.js
scripts.dev: npm run dev:wait && npm run dev:fix-db && npm run dev:services
scripts.dev:services: npx concurrently -n gateway,auth,course,order,admin,platform,platform-worker,downloads -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,gray,red "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:course" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:platform-worker" "npm run dev:downloads"
scripts.dev:gateway: cd services/api-gateway && cross-env PORT=3000 node --watch src/server.js
scripts.dev:auth: cd services/auth-service && cross-env PORT=4001 node --watch src/server.js
scripts.dev:course: cd services/course-service && cross-env PORT=4002 node --watch src/server.js
scripts.dev:order: cd services/order-service && cross-env PORT=4003 node --watch src/server.js
scripts.dev:admin: cd services/admin-service && cross-env PORT=4004 node --watch src/server.js
scripts.dev:platform: cd services/platform-service && cross-env PORT=4005 node --watch src/server.js
scripts.dev:downloads: cd services/downloads-service && cross-env PORT=4006 node --watch src/server.js
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/api-gateway && npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/course-service && npm install --prefix services/order-service && npm install --prefix services/admin-service && npm install --prefix services/platform-service && npm install --prefix services/downloads-service
scripts.dev:up: npm run dev:wait && npm run dev:fix-db && npm run dev:services
scripts.dev:free-ports: echo "Frees 3000 and 4001-4005 (stops any process bound to them)." && npm run dev:kill-ports
scripts.dev:kill-ports: for p in 3000 4001 4002 4003 4004 4005; do lsof -ti:$p 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; done; echo Done. Ports freed.
scripts.seed:admin: cross-env PORT=4001 npm run seed:admin --prefix services/auth-service
scripts.migrate:email-verified: cross-env PORT=4001 npm run migrate:email-verified --prefix services/auth-service
